attr.title: PKForge
attr.desc: PKForge 3.1.1 for ARM64 Linux handhelds: native save library, Pokémon and save editors, Bank organization and transfers, creation and reference tools, and Poképark. Development checkpoint; see the included coverage and validation ledger.
attr.inst: Extract into your firmware's Ports directory, keeping both launchers beside pkforge. PKForge opens Home; PKForge Pokepark opens the park directly. Preserve pkforge/userdata when updating. The .NET 10 runtime is bundled. Coverage and hardware acceptance are recorded separately in FEATURE_COVERAGE.md and VALIDATION.md.
